key: Exit the tutorial and begin the game?
en: Exit the tutorial and begin the game?
ja: チュートリアルを　終了して　ゲームを　始めますか?

key: Welcome to the Blindstep password tutorial.
en: Welcome to the Blindstep password tutorial.
ja: ブラインドステップ・パスワードチュートリアルへ　ようこそ。

key: In this tutorial, you'll have the opportunity to learn about and try out various audio cues in order to learn about the accessibility features of the game.
en: In this tutorial, you'll have the opportunity to learn about and try out various audio cues in order to learn about the accessibility features of the game.
ja: このチュートリアルでは　ゲームの　アクセシビリティ機能について　学ぶために　さまざまな音声の合図を　学び　試すことが　できます。

key: In order to help with item location and navigation from the outset, you'll be given an Itemfinder right away.
en: In order to help with item location and navigation from the outset, you'll be given an Itemfinder right away.
ja: アイテムの位置確認や　道案内を　最初から　助けるため　すぐに　ダウジングマシンが　渡されます。

key: Consider registering it through the bag for quick access.
en: Consider registering it through the bag for quick access.
ja: すぐに　使えるよう　バッグから　登録しておくと　いいでしょう。

key: If you would like to adjust the volume of blindstep- specific sounds, please look for the separate volume option in the Options menu.
en: If you would like to adjust the volume of blindstep- specific sounds, please look for the separate volume option in the Options menu.
ja: ブラインドステップ専用の音の音量を　調整したい場合は　オプションメニューの　個別の音量設定を　お探しください。

key: Additionally you can use the D key to get your current coordinates.
en: Additionally you can use the D key to get your current coordinates.
ja: さらに　Dキーを　使うと　現在の座標を　確認できます。

key: Guides meant for blind players generally use these coordinates for navigation.
en: Guides meant for blind players generally use these coordinates for navigation.
ja: 目の不自由なプレイヤー向けの攻略ガイドでは　通常　この座標を　使って　案内が　行われます。

key: The game features a native bump sound whenever you walk into a generic obstacle. It sounds like this:
en: The game features a native bump sound whenever you walk into a generic obstacle. It sounds like this:
ja: このゲームには　一般的な障害物に　ぶつかったときに　鳴る　標準の衝突音が　あります。こんな音です。

key: This bump sound may change or be accompanied by other sounds based on the type of object you are bumping into.
en: This bump sound may change or be accompanied by other sounds based on the type of object you are bumping into.
ja: この衝突音は　ぶつかる対象の種類によって　変わったり　他の音が　加わったり　することが　あります。

key: Various such objects have been placed on the top edge of this space. Try walking into them to learn about each sound.
en: Various such objects have been placed on the top edge of this space. Try walking into them to learn about each sound.
ja: この空間の上端には　そうしたさまざまな対象が　配置されています。それぞれに　ぶつかってみて　音を　確認してください。

key: To exit the tutorial and begin the game properly, walk as far down as possible at any time.
en: To exit the tutorial and begin the game properly, walk as far down as possible at any time.
ja: チュートリアルを　終了して　本編のゲームを　始めるには　いつでも　できる限り　下に　進んでください。

key: This is an item ball.
en: This is an item ball.
ja: これは　アイテムボールです。

key: This is the sound it makes when walked into.
en: This is the sound it makes when walked into.
ja: ぶつかったときに　鳴る音は　こちらです。

key: This particular item is fake and can't be picked up, but you'll know you can pick any other item up when you bump into that sound!
en: This particular item is fake and can't be picked up, but you'll know you can pick any other item up when you bump into that sound!
ja: この特定のアイテムは　偽物で　拾うことは　できませんが　他のアイテムでは　この音に　ぶつかれば　拾えると　わかります!

key: You've just jumped down the ledge!
en: You've just jumped down the ledge!
ja: だんさを　飛び降りた!

key: You've just walked into a ledge. This is the sound it makes.
en: You've just walked into a ledge. This is the sound it makes.
ja: だんさに　ぶつかりました。鳴る音は　こちらです。

key: Specifically, this is a downward facing ledge; you can only jump down it from above.
en: Specifically, this is a downward facing ledge; you can only jump down it from above.
ja: 具体的には　これは　下向きの　だんさで　上からしか　飛び降りることが　できません。

key: Try walking to the left, upward, and then right in order to make your way above this ledge. Then you can jump down.
en: Try walking to the left, upward, and then right in order to make your way above this ledge. Then you can jump down.
ja: このだんさの　上に　出るには　左　上　右の順に　進んでみてください。それから　飛び降りることが　できます。

key: This is a Pokémon! Specifically, Absol.
en: This is a Pokémon! Specifically, Absol.
ja: これは　ポケモンです! 具体的には　アブソルです。

key: They make this sound when bumped into.
en: They make this sound when bumped into.
ja: ぶつかると　この音が　鳴ります。

key: Many Pokémon will also play their cry when walked into.
en: Many Pokémon will also play their cry when walked into.
ja: 多くのポケモンは　ぶつかると　鳴き声も　再生されます。

key: Please be kind to them!
en: Please be kind to them!
ja: どうか　やさしく　してあげてください!

key: You've walked into an NPC character.
en: You've walked into an NPC character.
ja: NPCキャラクターに　ぶつかりました。

key: Don't worry, they don't mind.
en: Don't worry, they don't mind.
ja: 心配しないでください　彼らは　気にしません。

key: This is a berry tree.
en: This is a berry tree.
ja: これは　きのみの木です。

key: It plays this sound when bumped into.
en: It plays this sound when bumped into.
ja: ぶつかると　この音が　鳴ります。

key: You've just walked into grimey water.
en: You've just walked into grimey water.
ja: 濁った水に　ぶつかりました。

key: It's not very clean. You can fish in it, but not surf.
en: It's not very clean. You can fish in it, but not surf.
ja: あまり　きれいでは　ありません。釣りは　できますが　なみのりは　できません。

key: It makes this sound when walked into.
en: It makes this sound when walked into.
ja: ぶつかると　この音が　鳴ります。

key: You've just walked into clean water.
en: You've just walked into clean water.
ja: きれいな水に　ぶつかりました。

key: This is water you can both fish and surf in, provided you have the requisite Badge and Machine.
en: This is water you can both fish and surf in, provided you have the requisite Badge and Machine.
ja: これは　必要なバッジと　マシンを　持っていれば　釣りも　なみのりも　できる水です。

key: What you've just heard is the sound of bumping into a waterfall.
en: What you've just heard is the sound of bumping into a waterfall.
ja: 今　聞こえたのは　滝に　ぶつかった音です。

key: This isn't a real waterfall, since you're not surfing, but if it were, it would sound like that.
en: This isn't a real waterfall, since you're not surfing, but if it were, it would sound like that.
ja: なみのり中では　ないので　これは　本物の滝では　ありませんが　もし　そうならこんな音に　なります。

key: This is a tree that can be cut.
en: This is a tree that can be cut.
ja: これは　切り倒せる木です。

key: In this game, cutting trees in certain areas will also cause nearby vines to recede.
en: In this game, cutting trees in certain areas will also cause nearby vines to recede.
ja: このゲームでは　特定のエリアで　木を切ると　近くのツルも　後退することが　あります。

key: If that happens, you'll probably hear something like this after cutting it:
en: If that happens, you'll probably hear something like this after cutting it:
ja: それが　起こると　木を切ったあと　おそらく　こんな音が　聞こえます。

key: This is the sound a tree that you can use Headbutt on will make.
en: This is the sound a tree that you can use Headbutt on will make.
ja: これは　「ずつき」を　使える木の音です。

key: This isn't such a tree, but you can pretend it is, right?
en: This isn't such a tree, but you can pretend it is, right?
ja: これは　そういう木では　ありませんが　そのつもりで　聞いてみてください。

key: This is the sound a mirror makes when you walk into it.
en: This is the sound a mirror makes when you walk into it.
ja: これは　鏡に　ぶつかったときの音です。

key: In this game, many mirrors are objects that can be Smashed.
en: In this game, many mirrors are objects that can be Smashed.
ja: このゲームでは　多くの鏡が「かいりき」で　壊せる対象です。

key: Don't worry, we've taken the liberty of insulating our players from any resulting bad luck.
en: Don't worry, we've taken the liberty of insulating our players from any resulting bad luck.
ja: ご安心ください　その結果として　起こるかもしれない不運から　プレイヤーを　守るよう　配慮してあります。

key: This is the sound a climbable rock makes.
en: This is the sound a climbable rock makes.
ja: これは　登れる岩の音です。

key: You'll need the proper Badge and Machine to do so. It'll be a while!
en: You'll need the proper Badge and Machine to do so.  It'll be a while!
ja: それには　適切なバッジと　マシンが　必要です。まだ　少し　先の話ですが!

key: These rocks can take you upwards, sideways, down, or any number of places.
en: These rocks can take you upwards, sideways, down, or any number of places.
ja: こうした岩は　上や　横　下　その他　さまざまな場所へ　連れて行ってくれます。

key: Good luck exploring...
en: Good luck exploring...
ja: 探検を　楽しんでください……

key: This is the sound a rock or wall that can be smashed makes.
en: This is the sound a rock or wall that can be smashed makes.
ja: これは「かいりき」で　壊せる岩や壁の音です。

key: You'll need the proper Badge and Machine to do so.
en: You'll need the proper Badge and Machine to do so.
ja: それには　適切なバッジと　マシンが　必要です。

key: What's this mysterious object?
en: What's this mysterious object?
ja: この謎めいた物体は　何でしょう?

key: You won't see it for a long time, but this is a special cell belonging to a Legendary Pokémon.
en: You won't see it for a long time, but this is a special cell belonging to a Legendary Pokémon.
ja: しばらくは　目にすることは　ないでしょうが　これは　伝説のポケモンに　属する特別なセルです。

key: Pick them up whenever you find them!
en: Pick them up whenever you find them!
ja: 見つけたら　いつでも　拾ってください!

key: Have you already noticed the footstep sounds?
en: Have you already noticed the footstep sounds?
ja: もう　足音に　気づきましたか?

key: They change slightly based on what direction you've moved.
en: They change slightly based on what direction you've moved.
ja: 移動した方向によって　少しずつ　変化します。

key: This one is down...
en: This one is down...
ja: これは　下……

key: Here's left...
en: Here's left...
ja: こちらは　左……

key: Here's right...
en: Here's right...
ja: こちらは　右……

key: And finally, up!
en: And finally, up!
ja: そして　最後に　上!

key: We'll play a sound whenever you're right next to an item.
en: We'll play a sound whenever you're right next to an item.
ja: アイテムの　すぐそばに　いるときは　音が　鳴ります。

key: Hello, Voltorb!
en: Hello, Voltorb!
ja: こんにちは　ビリリダマ!

key: Like other ambient sounds, the pan and pitch of this sound will change based on which direction the item is in.
en: Like other ambient sounds, the pan and pitch of this sound will change based on which direction the item is in.
ja: 他の環境音と　同じように　この音の　左右の広がりと　音程は　アイテムが　どの方向に　あるかによって　変わります。

key: There's no item this time, but if you hear it in the future, look around!
en: There's no item this time, but if you hear it in the future, look around!
ja: 今回は　アイテムは　ありませんが　今後　この音が　聞こえたら　あたりを　見回してください!

key: We'll play a sound whenever you're right next to an event.
en: We'll play a sound whenever you're right next to an event.
ja: イベントの　すぐそばに　いるときも　音が　鳴ります。

key: ...Unfortunately, what qualifies as an Event is a little up in the air.
en: ...Unfortunately, what qualifies as an Event is a little up in the air.
ja: ……残念ながら　何を「イベント」とみなすかは　少し　あいまいです。

key: The game code uses Events for all sorts of things, from objects for puzzles to cosmetic effects to obstacles and walls to other NPCs.
en: The game code uses Events for all sorts of things, from objects for puzzles to cosmetic effects to obstacles and walls to other NPCs.
ja: ゲームのコードは　パズル用のオブジェクトから　演出効果　障害物や壁　他のNPCまで　あらゆるものに　イベントを　使っています。

key: Unfortunately there's no way that we can helpfully specify and label all of them.
en: Unfortunately there's no way that we can helpfully specify and label all of them.
ja: 残念ながら　そのすべてを　わかりやすく　特定して　ラベル付けする方法は　ありません。

key: If you hear this sound, assume that there is a chance something interesting is near you-- it is not a guarantee.
en: If you hear this sound, assume that there is a chance something interesting is near you-- it is not a guarantee.
ja: この音が　聞こえたら　近くに　何か　興味深いものが　あるかもしれないと　思ってください―― 保証は　できませんが。

key: This game will play Ambient sound based on your surroundings.
en: This game will play Ambient sound based on your surroundings.
ja: このゲームは　周囲の状況に　応じて　環境音を　再生します。

key: Here's for if it's below you...
en: Here's for if it's below you...
ja: これは　下に　ある場合……

key: Here's to you left...
en: Here's to you left...
ja: こちらは　左に　ある場合……

key: And finally, above!
en: And finally, above!
ja: そして　最後に　上に　ある場合!

key: Thanks to Aaron Vgstorm from Manamon for these sounds!
en: Thanks to Aaron Vgstorm from Manamon for these sounds!
ja: これらの音は　Manamonの　Aaron　Vgstorm氏に　感謝します!

key: Here's a sound that should play when an Event is in line with you.
en: Here's a sound that should play when an Event is in line with you.
ja: これは　イベントが　あなたと　一直線上に　あるときに　鳴るはずの音です。

key: We'll play a sound whenever you're near a door.
en: We'll play a sound whenever you're near a door.
ja: ドアの近くに　いるときも　音を　鳴らします。

key: What specifically counts as a 'Door' is difficult to define. We're still working on identifying it properly.
en: What specifically counts as a 'Door' is difficult to define. We're still working on identifying it properly.
ja: 具体的に　何が「ドア」に　当たるかを　定義するのは　難しく　正確に　識別する作業は　今も　続けています。

key: Hopefully this will be more comprehensively accurate in the future!
en: Hopefully this will be more comprehensively accurate in the future!
ja: 今後　もっと　包括的に　正確に　なることを　願っています!

key: We've added some sounds to help you out when you can get to fishing.
en: We've added some sounds to help you out when you can get to fishing.
ja: 釣りが　できるように　なったときに　役立つ音も　いくつか　追加しました。

key: This is the sound that you'll hear several times when fishing.
en: This is the sound that you'll hear several times when fishing.
ja: これは　釣りの間　何度か　聞こえる音です。

key: Eventually, you'll hear a new sound. This is how you know it's time to press the button to reel it in!
en: Eventually, you'll hear a new sound. This is how you know it's time to press the button to reel it in!
ja: やがて　新しい音が　聞こえます。これが　リールを巻く　ボタンを　押す合図です!

key: If your fish gets away, you'll hear this...
en: If your fish gets away, you'll hear this...
ja: 魚に　逃げられたときは　この音が　聞こえます……

key: But if you succeeded, you'll hear this sound, and the battle will begin!
en: But if you succeeded, you'll hear this sound, and the battle will begin!
ja: でも　成功したら　この音が　聞こえて　バトルが　始まります!

key: When you're out surfing, you might hear this sound...
en: When you're out surfing, you might hear this sound...
ja: なみのり中に　この音が　聞こえることが　あります……

key: This means there's deep water below you!
en: This means there's deep water below you!
ja: これは　あなたの下に　深い水が　あるという意味です!

key: If you have the requisite Badge and Machine, press the action button to Dive below!
en: If you have the requisite Badge and Machine, press the action button to Dive below!
ja: 必要なバッジと　マシンを　持っていれば　アクションボタンを　押して　ダイビングで　もぐりましょう!

key: Alternatively, when you're underwater already, you might hear this!
en: Alternatively, when you're underwater already, you might hear this!
ja: あるいは　すでに　水中に　いるときは　この音が　聞こえることも　あります!

key: That means you're in a good place to resurface!
en: That means you're in a good place to resurface!
ja: それは　浮上するのに　ちょうどいい場所という　合図です!

key: Press the action button to come up for air.
en: Press the action button to come up for air.
ja: アクションボタンを　押して　水面に　上がりましょう。

key: This sound will play whenever you're walking through grass.
en: This sound will play whenever you're walking through grass.
ja: 草むらを　歩いているときは　この音が　鳴ります。

key: The area below here is full of grass.
en: The area below here is full of grass.
ja: この下のエリアは　草むらだらけです。

key: There are no more tutorials below this space. Continuing further down through the grass will exit the area.
en: There are no more tutorials below this space.  Continuing further down through the grass will exit the area.
ja: この空間より下には　チュートリアルは　ありません。草むらを　さらに　下へ　進むと　このエリアから　出ます。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
